title: Novo Machineries: A Website Design and Development Case Study for a Woodworking Machinery Supplier in Ajman, UAE
storyLead: How Teknoppy designed a service-and-support website for an Ajman machinery trader, helping furniture and joinery workshops across the Middle East see what Novo sells, how it installs and maintains every machine, and how to call the team directly.
atAGlance: Novo sells woodworking machines and supports them after the sale, with installation, maintenance, repair, spare parts and operator training
The website leads with this full-service promise, not just a list of machines
Products are grouped by the workshop they serve: doors and frames, kitchen cabinets and office furniture
A one-tap phone link and a clear Ajman address make it easy for workshop owners to reach the team
The site runs on WordPress, so Novo's team can add machines, brands and gallery images as the range grows
aboutParagraphs: Novo Workshop Equipment & Machines Trading LLC is a woodworking machinery supplier based at Al Hakim Building, Mowaihat 1, in Ajman, UAE. It serves furniture makers, joinery workshops and interior fit-out manufacturers across the Middle East.

Its range includes panel saws, beam saws, planers, routers, sanders and edge banding machines, the core equipment of any modern woodworking shop. Novo positions itself on trust, customised solutions and industry expertise, helping each client choose machines that match their production needs.

What sets Novo apart is the support that follows a sale. Its team handles installation and setup, preventive maintenance, repairs and spare parts, technical support, and training and demonstrations. Teknoppy was brought in to present Novo as a long-term machinery partner for workshops in Ajman, Sharjah, Dubai and beyond.
challengeLead: Five problems shaped the design brief.

challenges.title: A support business that looked like a shop
challenges.description: Selling machines is only half of what Novo does. The website needed to show installation, maintenance and training just as clearly as the products.

challenges.title: Buyers who think in workshops, not models
challenges.description: A kitchen-cabinet maker and a door manufacturer need different machine sets. The site had to speak to each type of workshop.

challenges.title: A crowded Northern Emirates market
challenges.description: Ajman and Sharjah host many machinery traders. Novo needed to look established and dependable at first glance.

challenges.title: Owners who prefer to call
challenges.description: Workshop owners often decide over a phone call, frequently from the shop floor. Contact had to be one tap away.

challenges.title: Limited time to read
challenges.description: Busy owners scan rather than read. Every section needed to make its point in a few lines.

objectiveLead: The goal was a clear, professional industrial equipment supplier website that shows Novo as a full-service machinery partner and turns visits into calls.
objectives: Give installation, maintenance and training equal weight with sales
Organise products around the workshops they serve
Make calling Novo possible in one tap from any page
Build trust with a clear vision, real images and a visible Ajman address
approachLead: Six design pillars, each tied to how workshop owners choose a supplier.

approachPillars.title: A homepage that leads with service
paragraphs: After the opening slider, the homepage presents Novo's main services, sales, installation and setup, maintenance and repair, and training and demonstrations, as equal blocks, so visitors understand the full offer immediately.

approachPillars.title: Product lines by workshop type
paragraphs: Products are grouped under Doors and Frames, Kitchen Cabinets and Office Furniture, reflecting how manufacturers plan their equipment rather than how a catalogue is printed.

approachPillars.title: A visual slider and gallery
paragraphs: A full-width slider and an image gallery show machines and workshop settings. Large, clear images do more for an industrial buyer than paragraphs of description, especially on a phone screen.

approachPillars.title: Vision and values made visible
paragraphs: An "Our Vision" section and short statements on trust, customised solutions and expertise explain why workshops choose Novo, not just what it sells.

approachPillars.title: One-tap calling and a clear address
paragraphs: The phone number is a clickable link, and the Ajman address appears in the footer, so a workshop owner can call or plan a visit without searching.

approachPillars.title: A service-rich footer
paragraphs: The footer lists preventive maintenance, repairs and spare parts, technical support, and training and consultancy alongside the product lines, reinforcing Novo's after-sales strength on every page.

deliverables.title: A service-first homepage
deliverables.description: Sales, installation, maintenance and training given equal space.

deliverables.title: Workshop-based product sections
deliverables.description: Doors and frames, kitchen cabinets and office furniture lines.

deliverables.title: Click-to-call contact and footer navigation
deliverables.description: Fast routes to the team from every page.

whyMattersHeading: Why after-sales support wins machinery buyers in the UAE
whyMattersParagraphs: Buying a beam saw or an edge bander is a long-term decision. A workshop owner in Ajman or Sharjah is not just comparing prices. They are asking who will install the machine, who will fix it when it stops and who will train their operators. A supplier whose website answers those questions upfront earns trust before the first call.

The industrial areas of Ajman and Sharjah host many furniture, joinery and fit-out workshops, many of them small and owner-run. For these buyers, a simple, fast website with a visible phone number and a real local address matters more than a complex online store.

Training is an often-overlooked selling point. Many workshops hire operators who are new to CNC routers or beam saws, and a supplier that teaches them reduces downtime and mistakes. Putting training on the homepage turns a cost worry into a reason to buy. Grouping products by workshop type also makes growth easy, as each new machine fits a structure buyers already understand.
whyMattersCalloutHtml:
For a machinery supplier, the website should sell the relationship, not just the machine.
